tickets.name: Dame Time
tickets.note: Knock knock. Who's there? Buckets. Big man, big jump, big chance. That's Wembanyama at the start of the night. When the ball goes up, he's the one coming down with it. Richardson drifts to the dunker spot and waits for the gift. The ball barely leaves the ref's hand before Huff slaps it to the Pacers. Green paws the tip, rolls to the rim, and the Warriors feed him. Hang on to the railing, folks.

tickets.name: The Bank Is Open
tickets.note: Line 'em up! Wrecking-Ball Wembanyama taps it back and posts up before the defense ties its shoes. Richardson is the sleeper pick, and we're setting an alarm for him. Opening minute, Reid gets the ball at the top of the key, and it's go time. Tip goes to the Rockets, and Capela is rumbling down the lane right behind it. Nobody on the slate gets off the floor at the opening tip quite like him. We're letting it ride, baby!

tickets.name: The Block
tickets.note: It's a four-course meal. Jump ball, and Atomic Adebayo plays it like a volleyball spike. Just when the defense loads up on the stars, Rattlesnake Richardson slips in the side door. Early clock, Bailey on the elbow, and you can see the wheels turning: he's shooting this. With the guts of a cat burglar! Here's Huff at the opening toss, long arms, big hands, bigger plans. Let 'er rip!

tickets.name: Sky Hook
tickets.note: Strike up the band! Adebayo squares up in the circle, the whistle blows, and he's already in the air. Don't look now, but Richardson is lurking for the Magic. Holy guacamole! Green flicks the tip to the wing like he's dealing cards. Before the sweat even starts, Reid has the ball and a look in his eye. Bless its heart, this ticket's got big dreams.

tickets.name: Dream Shake
tickets.note: Ladies and gentlemen, your starting lineup! Here we go: Reed versus the other big, and Reed gets there a hair early. The opening tip is his specialty, and the Pistons know it. Here's Richardson, the guy you'd skip on the program and shouldn't. Big-Time Bailey doesn't wait for the game. He goes and gets it. Ball goes up, Hurricane Huff goes up higher, and the Pacers have it. That's a ticket you write home about!

tickets.name: Flu Game
tickets.note: Reed is the headliner. Rocket Reed gets the tip, the Pistons get the ball, and the big fella gets position. Richardson sneaks in for the Magic like a cat burglar in sneakers. Tip to the Warriors, a quick swing, and Green is sealing his man under the basket. Capela plants his feet in the circle like a porch post in red clay. He wins those tips like he's got the ref on speed dial. Put it in the oven and let it bake.

tickets.name: Linsanity
tickets.note: It's a barn dance, y'all. There's Allen in the circle, long as a summer day, and twice as hot. Richardson is the dark horse in the Magic barn, and that horse can run. The Jazz call Bailey's number first, and he doesn't need asking twice. Hot biscuit, right out of the oven! Win the tip, then dive to the rim: that's how Huff likes to start the evening. Somebody get the camera rolling.

tickets.name: Iso Joe
tickets.note: Road trip! First stop, Allen. Center jump, Allen against the world, and the world is losing. Richardson gets the leftovers, and some nights the leftovers are the whole buffet. Tougher than woodpecker lips! Gusher Green gets a fingernail on the toss, and a fingernail is all he needs. Reid catches it on the wing, and that trigger finger is itchy. It's a lottery ticket with a jump shot!

tickets.name: Bad Boys
tickets.note: Here comes the parade! Toss goes up, and Wembanyama meets it like they had a lunch date. He has been owning that circle all season long. Hidden gem alert: Richardson for the Magic. Huff wins the tip, gets it right back on the block, and goes to work. Go on and get it, boys!

tickets.name: Seven Seconds or Less
tickets.note: Spin the wheel! Wembanyama tips it forward and beats everybody to the rim. Green gets up so high on the tip he could change a light bulb. Opening set, Reid on the move, and he's shooting it before you can say tip-off. Smoother than grandma's gravy! Cue the confetti cannon!

tickets.name: Grit and Grind
tickets.note: Roll call! Adebayo springs off that hardwood like somebody swapped it for a trampoline. Richardson is the fella the scouting report put on page nine, and that's where we found him. Quicker than a hummingbird's wings! Bailey gets loose in transition off the very first stop, and he's not passing it. Fire up the jukebox, we're feeling good.

tickets.name: Splash Brothers
tickets.note: Grab a plate. Adebayo rakes the tip and trots to the block like he owns the place. He's been first to the ball on the opening toss all year. Huff gets the jump on the jump ball, and the Pacers are in business. Here's Green, crouched and coiled at center court. Up he goes. Swing big, baby!

tickets.name: Run TMC
tickets.note: Four tips go up tonight. Reed reaches for the rafters on the opening toss and taps it home to the Pistons. Now here's a name nobody circled: Richardson for the Magic. Quicker than a preacher's amen! Bailey gets the first look, and he never met a first look he didn't like. We're swinging for the rafters tonight.

tickets.name: Twin Towers
tickets.note: Fresh out the oven! Reed wins it clean, then camps out on the block waiting for the entry pass. He controls that toss more nights than he doesn't. The ref flips it, Huff flicks it, and the Pacers are off to the races. Green wins the tip, and the Warriors run the first set right back through him. Four doors, four keys, let's open 'em up.

tickets.name: The Process
tickets.note: Saddle up, partner. Allen times the toss like a man catching the last bus home. Here's Richardson, flying under the radar so low he's scraping the parking lot. Bailey pulls the trigger first, asks questions later. Hotter than a jalapeño in a sauna! Bold as brass, and twice as shiny.

tickets.name: Heat Culture
tickets.note: Hold onto the porch railing. Allen at the opening jump, and he's got springs in those sneakers tonight. Ref throws it up, Huff sends it to the Pacers with a smile. Stronger than truck-stop coffee! Green gets the first touch with his fingertips, the second with both hands. Tip it off already, I can't stand the wait!
